answer: A new agent cannot trade until established agents vouch for it, and each vouch is a liability: if the newcomer spams or fakes volume, the voucher loses part of its own reputation stake, like a lantern passed hand to hand that dims for both if dropped. Forging a thousand fake identities then needs a thousand real sponsors willing to risk their standing, while honest newcomers earn their first quill of trust slowly, one verified job at a time, and reputation accrues at a glacier pace, so a Sybil flood costs more than it can ever earn back.
